categories.main_business_segments: The company operates in two primary business segments: (1) Lithium-ion battery negative electrode materials business, which focuses on research, development, production and sales of negative electrode materials for lithium-ion batteries used in power, energy storage and consumer electronics applications; (2) Electromagnetic equipment business, which manufactures and sells electromagnetic metallurgical equipment, industrial magnetic equipment and lithium-ion battery specialized equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses advanced technologies in graphite powder processing, heat treatment processes, and graphite composite technology. It has developed proprietary fully-automatic intelligent graphite furnaces with advantages in low power consumption, reduced furnace core material costs, high automation levels and environmental protection. The company also maintains strong capabilities in magnetic force separation technology, electrical automation control, numerical simulation analysis and engineering application for electromagnetic equipment manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: For negative electrode materials, the company serves major lithium-ion battery manufacturers including BYD, CATL, CITIC New Aviation, EVE Energy, Refulong Energy, Honeycomb Energy, ATL and international customers like SK On and LGES. For electromagnetic equipment, the company maintains stable relationships with most domestic steel enterprises and major metallurgical engineering contractors. The company's products serve power battery, energy storage battery and consumer electronics markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing facilities in Hunan, Guizhou, Yunnan, Sichuan and Anhui provinces. It has established sales presence across major regions including North China, East China, South China, Southwest China, Northwest China and Northeast China. The company is expanding international presence with overseas sales reaching 7.31% of total revenue in 2023.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the lithium-ion battery supply chain. For negative electrode materials, it processes raw materials (petroleum coke, needle coke) into finished negative electrode products for battery manufacturers. For electromagnetic equipment, it manufactures specialized equipment used in steel production and battery manufacturing processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes development of high-performance negative electrode materials including fast-charging, high energy density and ultra-long cycle life products. Strategic R&D focuses on silicon-carbon, hard carbon and other new-type negative electrode materials. The company is advancing graphitization technology, developing equipment for intelligent and green manufacturing, and expanding into energy storage and international markets. R&D investment reached 5.15% of revenue in 2023.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of products. For negative electrode materials, revenue is recognized upon delivery to customers and acceptance. For electromagnetic equipment, revenue is recognized upon product delivery, customer acceptance or installation completion. The company uses a combination of order-based production and inventory management strategies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In negative electrode materials, the company competes with Betery, Shanghai Shanshan and other manufacturers. The company maintains first-mover advantages in power battery negative electrode materials with over 20 years of experience. In electromagnetic equipment, the company holds market-leading position with over 60% market share in electromagnetic stirring equipment for continuous casting, competing with international players like ABB and Danieli-Rotelec.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-to-large scale manufacturer with 2023 revenue of 4.91 billion yuan, down 6.64% from 2022. Net profit attributable to parent company was 41.7 million yuan in 2023 compared to 364.1 million yuan in 2022, reflecting market challenges. The company maintains total assets of 10.37 billion yuan and employs approximately 3,815 people. Growth has moderated due to negative electrode material market oversupply and price declines.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through proprietary graphitization technology with lower power consumption and higher automation compared to traditional methods. It offers complete negative electrode material production line design, construction and operation capabilities. The company provides customized electromagnetic equipment solutions with advanced magnetic force separation and electrical automation control. Strong R&D capabilities, established customer relationships with major battery manufacturers, and integrated supply chain management provide competitive advantages.
